title: Pix Gets New Rules for Fraud Prevention, Hybrid Billing, and Payroll Accounts
seoTitle: New Pix Rules: Fraud, Hybrid Billing & Payroll
subtitle: The Central Bank announces changes to Pix regulations to expand features and enhance security
excerpt: Brazil's Central Bank announces updates to Pix rules, including anti-fraud measures, hybrid billing, and payroll account integration.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Central Bank of Brazil announced updates to Pix regulations to expand features, bolster security, and improve the instant payment system.

Among the changes are specific new rules designed to tackle fraud, roll out a hybrid billing model, and regulate payroll accounts, aiming to offer greater user protection and ensure clearer transactions.

These adjustments aim to align Pix with growing security and usability demands, further cementing its position as the country's primary electronic payment method.

With information from Agência Brasil.
